name: host-durable-logs
title: Editor host: durable log output (stderr sink, optional log file) so audit, rate-limit and reload lines survive in journald and docker logs
issue: Follow-up approved by the user 2026-10-14 after hardening PR D (#133): docs/editor.html and docs/logging-and-editor.html now state that a RELEASE editor host prints no log lines (the logging system has no console subscriber in release, so the audit lines (user=<u> role=<r> peer=<addr>, 'audit:' per mutating command), rate-limit ban/unban lines and token-reload lines are only visible through the editor protocol's PollEvents, never in the journal or `docker logs`). Fix it. First read: docs/logging-and-editor.html, the engine's logging code (grep for the Log/Logger subscriber/sink interfaces under engine/ and editor-server/), editor-server/src/Host.cpp and HostOptions.cpp (how the host starts, its flags, how Debug builds print), and the 'Not covered / no durable audit trail' wording PR D added in docs/editor.html. Scope: (1) the editor host (N2EditorHost, Host.cpp) installs a log sink that writes one line per log event to STDERR with a timestamp and level (works under systemd journald and docker logs without extra config), enabled by default for the host binary in ALL build types, with a minimum level option (e.g. `--log-level debug|info|warn|error`, default info) so polled-command noise stays out (polled commands are already silent; keep Debug-level lines off by default). (2) Optional `--log-file <path>`: append the same lines to a file (opened append-only; on POSIX create it with mode 0600 so audit lines are not world readable; refuse an obviously unwritable path at start with a clear error; no rotation in this PR, document that logrotate with copytruncate or a restart is needed, or reopen on SIGUSR1 ONLY if trivial and tested). (3) Make absolutely sure no token material, token hash or Hello token ever reaches any sink (re-audit every log call in editor-server/ and the new sink: only user names that passed IsValidTokenUserName, SanitizeForLog on client-supplied text) and add a test that drives a failed Hello with a recognisable fake token and asserts the token text and its hash never appear in captured sink output. (4) Tests that run on every leg: sink formatting (timestamp injectable or pattern-matched, level filter), the file sink (temp dir, append, 0600 on POSIX, unwritable path error), and an end-to-end socket test that a refused Hello, a mutating command (audit line) and a rate-limit ban (injected clock/address provider from PR C) produce the expected lines in a captured sink; the sink must not change behaviour of the Debug console output or of PollEvents (the editor still receives the same events). (5) Docs: remove or rewrite the 'no durable audit trail' limitation in docs/editor.html, docs/logging-and-editor.html and docs/testing.html, document the flags, the line format, and the journald/docker examples (`journalctl -u n2editorhost`, `docker logs`); update the systemd units/compose only where a flag is needed (deploy/ is in scope, keep edits minimal). No protocol change. Nothing builds locally; CI is the build (8 checks, required `linux (Release, x86_64, Clang)`); the docker leg's smoke step can assert a line shows up in `docker logs` if straightforward (tests/smoke, tests.yml in scope), otherwise list it as unverified.
acceptance: Release host writes audit, rate-limit and reload lines to stderr (and optionally a 0600 log file)
Test proves token text and hash never appear in sink output
Docs updated: no 'no durable audit trail' limitation left; flags documented
notes: Security-adjacent: reviewer checks no token material in any log path, the file mode, that stderr logging cannot block or crash the host (closed stderr, EPIPE/SIGPIPE: the host already ignores SIGPIPE), no behaviour change to PollEvents/Debug output, and log volume (no per-poll lines). Unverified: journald/docker logs on real systems, logrotate behaviour.
